name: Jacky Ickx
features: dark hair, boyish face, intense dark eyes, compact build, unhurried manner
bio: Ferrari's number one in 1970, the man who walked to his car at the last Le Mans start in 1969 and won anyway. Drove the works 512S to victory at Sebring with Mario Andretti's help and led Le Mans until the rain and the Ferrari pile-up at Maison Blanche ended it. Rain never slowed him.
